scene: Dropping down the hatch, you enter a secret underground depot.
picture: A flat side view along a concrete depot floor. Far left, a yellow delivery truck stands with open rear doors. Centre left, the player sits in her purple wheelchair beside a drop pipe. Centre, a small steam train rests on rails. Far right, an anchored brass airship floats beside a wooden ramp.
shown: A yellow delivery truck with open doors waits parked on the far left
A striped steam train idles quietly on tracks in the centre
A tethered brass airship sways gently near a ramp on the far right

variants.scene: Steam puffs as you roll into a hidden underground vehicle bay.
